summary:
Implemented the Diagnostics iPhone First Check Tracker.

It adds `diagnostics.html#first-check-tracker` with five symptom contexts, four tap-to-mark first checks per context, local persistence, Copy/Share, and Save Garage Note through the existing Garage Notes path. Search now finds the tracker, and the service worker cache is bumped to `ridgeline-console-v382`.
